blocks.subtitle: Your stress regulation
blocks.claim: What is measured is not stress itself, but how well your body regulates it. Six microRNAs from a single drop of capillary blood give an insight into the cellular control of your stress response.
blocks.benefit: How your client's body handles stress — and what they can change.

blocks.caption: The principle
blocks.title: Your stress regulation. Not your stress level.
blocks.lead: Stress is not a single quantity but a network of neuroendocrine, immunological and metabolic processes — controlled, among other things, via the HPA axis, inflammatory signalling pathways and mitochondrial adaptations. Six microRNAs are analysed: small, non-coding RNA molecules that help determine which genes are actually read under stress conditions.

cards.title: Acute & chronic
cards.text: How your stress response is currently running and whether a lasting burden is emerging.

cards.title: Regulation
cards.text: How well your body balances stress signals at the cellular level.

cards.title: Long-term effects
cards.text: How high the risk is that sustained stress will make itself felt in the long term.

flow.title: Measure
flow.text: Dried blood spot card, fingertip. Six microRNAs, normalised to the reference gene miR-24-3p. No fasting required.

flow.title: Evaluate
flow.text: Two evaluations on the 1–9 scale: physiological stress level and risk of long-term effects.

flow.title: Regulate
flow.text: Targeted recommendations on plant-derived bioactive compounds and follow-up monitoring over time.

blocks.scaleTitle: How do I read the scale?
blocks.scaleLead: Both evaluations and all six individual markers run on the scale from 1 to 9. Higher is always better: 1–3 red, 4–6 amber, 7–9 green. Each of the two evaluations additionally carries its own zone labelling.

blocks.title: Important
blocks.text: This report is not a diagnosis and does not replace medical or psychotherapeutic advice. If strain, exhaustion or sleep problems persist, please seek medical advice.
items: The six microRNA values describe a snapshot in time and can be influenced through lifestyle — which makes them suitable for monitoring over time.

items.name: Physiological stress level
items.text: Your body is coping well with current stress.

blocks.caption: The six individual markers
blocks.title: All microRNAs at a glance.
blocks.note: The two evaluations are calculated by the laboratory from the microRNAs assigned to them; they are not the average of these individual values.

blocks.caption: Evaluation 01
blocks.title: Physiological stress level.
blocks.lead: Composed of the acute and the chronic stress indicator (let-7a-5p, let-7g-5p).
blocks.text: The evaluation shows where your current stress response lies between ‘no stress’ and ‘chronic stress’. Your value is in the favourable range — your body is coping well with current stress. The assessment is always made in the context of the other markers.

items.name: let-7a-5p
items.text: Part of the let-7 family; regulates inflammatory signalling pathways and is involved in stress and immune processes. The more favourable of the two values.

items.name: let-7g-5p
items.text: Regulates inflammatory and metabolic processes that influence systemic homeostasis. Markedly weaker than the acute indicator.

blocks.title: What matters here
blocks.text: The two individual indicators diverge widely: acute 7/9, chronic 4/9. The acute stress response is working; the chronic level is the weaker of the two.
items: Four of the eleven recommendations — quercetin, EGCG, oleuropein and resveratrol — target precisely the chronic indicator let-7g-5p.

blocks.caption: Evaluation 02
blocks.title: Risk of long-term effects.
blocks.lead: Calculated from four microRNAs: miR-16-5p, miR-15a-5p, miR-106b-5p and miR-21-5p.
blocks.text: The evaluation does not yet show any acute stress-related overload. The risk of secondary conditions is, however, already elevated — it is worth acting here before long-term effects become manifest. This is the focus of your report.

items.name: miR-106b-5p
items.text: Regulates immune responses and inflammatory signalling pathways. The only red individual value in this report; four of the eleven recommendations address it.

items.name: miR-15a-5p
items.text: Regulates neuronal processes, apoptosis and the cell cycle; influences neuronal homeostasis.

items.name: miR-16-5p
items.text: Regulates serotonergic signalling pathways and the serotonin transporter; involved in neuronal plasticity.

items.name: miR-21-5p
items.text: Regulates cell survival and apoptosis; involved in stress and repair processes. The best individual value in the entire report.

blocks.caption: Trend
blocks.title: Two measurements compared.
blocks.lead: A comparison of your two measurements to date. Only measured values are shown — no prognosis.

blocks.title: What the trend shows
blocks.text: The two evaluations are moving in opposite directions: the current stress level has improved from 6 to 7 and is now in the green range. The value for long-term effects has fallen from 5 to 4 over the same period — and because a higher value here means a lower risk, this means the risk has increased.
items: This is the real finding of this measurement: acute strain is being coped with better, while the long-term regulatory level has deteriorated. A good stress level alone says nothing about the long-term effects level.
The two measurements were around three months apart. The interval until the next follow-up measurement is set by the supervising institution.

blocks.caption: Summary
blocks.title: Your focus: the long view.
blocks.lead: Your current stress level is good — and that is precisely the point at which this report pushes back: the level that has deteriorated is the one you cannot feel.

focuses.title: miR-106b-5p — the only red individual value
focuses.text: At 3/9, the immune signal activating indicator is the weakest value in the report and feeds into the risk of long-term effects. Four of the eleven recommendations target it: resveratrol, berberine, butyrate and omega-3. In concrete terms: at least 30 g of fibre daily for butyrate formation in the gut, 250–500 mg of omega-3 from oily fish, walnuts or algal oil, plus berries for resveratrol.

focuses.title: let-7g-5p — the chronic level
focuses.text: At 4/9, the chronic stress indicator lies well below the acute one (7/9) — even though the evaluation as a whole is in the green range. The report does not show which of the two indicators carried the improvement from 6 to 7. Quercetin, EGCG, oleuropein and resveratrol act on the chronic level. The preparation notes differ from compound to compound — details in the table on page 06.

blocks.keepText: miR-21-5p (8/9) and let-7a-5p (7/9) are the two strongest values — cellular protective mechanisms and the acute stress response are working well. Curcumin, gingerol and sulforaphane serve to maintain here, not to correct.

In cases of persistent exhaustion, sleep problems or low mood, this report does not replace medical assessment.

blocks.title: Questions about your report?
blocks.text: Discuss the results with the institution that carried out the sample collection. That is where the context needed to interpret them is held.

legal.title: Sample report
legal.text: All values and personal details in this document are fictitious and serve solely to illustrate the report format. This is not a real report.

legal.title: Interpretation
legal.text: This report is not a diagnosis and does not replace medical or psychotherapeutic advice. The microRNA values describe a snapshot of cellular regulation; they are not a measurement of perceived stress and make no statement about the presence or development of a disease. If strain, exhaustion, sleep problems or low mood persist, please seek medical advice.
